[[File:Rapid_fire_laser_cannon.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A rapid fire laser cannon mounted on a Mobile Defense Unit.]]
The '''rapid fire laser cannon''' was a remote turret which fired a continuous stream of lasers from four barrels until it or its enemy was destroyed. It was effective against both infantry and vehicles. It was used on [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Mobile Defense Unit]]s and by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] as a type of turret.
